extensionDescription.message: Learns targets with connection errors and routes only them through a local compatibility gateway.

tagline.message: Detects errors, learns, and routes only the target

privacyNote.message: The learned list stays on your device. The extension does not change your computer's DNS settings. A domain is sent to Globalping only when you select “Check global status”.

diagnosticPrivacy.message: Only when you select this button is the domain sent to Globalping for measurements from three continents.

learnedHint.message: × removes the target for now; Ignore removes it and prevents relearning after future errors.

neverLearnSites.message: Sites that will not be learned automatically

ignoredHint.message: Ignored targets are not added to automatic routing even after connection errors. Use ↩ on a row to restore one.

gatewayHint.message: For security, it connects only to the SOCKS5 gateway on this computer.

debugHint.message: Only time, domain, request/error type, and routing stage are kept on the device; page content is not recorded.

noLearnedTargets.message: No blocked target has been detected yet

reloadInstruction.message: Select the reload icon on the Automatic Access card at chrome://extensions.

proxyControlled.message: The proxy setting is controlled by another extension or administrator.

detectionWaiting.message: Targets are saved after connection errors; only a failed main page is reloaded once.

directMode.message: Chrome is connecting directly; block detection is inactive.

backgroundOutdated.message: The background code is still on an older version. Reload the extension card and reopen the popup.

notificationFailed.message: The last notification could not be shown: $1

notificationSettingsHint.message: Check Chrome or Windows notification settings.

locationsResponded.message: $1/$2 external locations returned an HTTP response.

siteOnlineDetail.message: $1 The site is reachable externally; the issue may be on the local network or regional route.

outageLikelyDetail.message: External locations on at least two continents could not reach the target; the issue is probably not on your device.

regionalIssueDetail.message: $1 The site is not completely offline, but it is not reachable from every region.

statusInconclusive.message: Global status could not be confirmed

statusInconclusiveDetail.message: The external measurements are inconclusive; try again later.

clientFilterTitle.message: A browser filter stopped the application

clientFilterDetail.message: A first-party application file was blocked by another content filter. Check the site exception, then reload without using the broken cache.

routeFailedTitle.message: The issue continues after the gateway attempt

routeFailedDetail.message: The target is already using the automatic gateway. The site may be offline or experiencing a different connection issue.

transientDetail.message: The direct check received a response. The site was not added to routing; you can retry the page.

unverifiedDetail.message: This error alone does not prove an access block. The target was not added automatically; retry or check global status.

alternativeDetail.message: The target was learned and is loading once more through the local gateway.

operationFailed.message: The operation could not be completed.

refreshBeforeContinue.message: Reload the extension at chrome://extensions before continuing.

invalidPort.message: The port must be between 1 and 65535.

settingsApplied.message: Automatic connection settings were applied to Chrome.

ruleReapplied.message: The automatic proxy rule was reapplied.

logCopied.message: The debug log was copied to the clipboard.

logCopyFailed.message: The log could not be copied: $1

testNotificationSent.message: The test notification was sent to Chrome. If it is not visible, check Windows Notification Center and Do not disturb.

notificationCreationFailed.message: The notification could not be created.

learnedOneMessage.message: $1 will now be tried through the local gateway.

routeRestoredMessage.message: $1 is reachable directly again and was removed from automatic routing.

notificationTestMessage.message: If you can see this notification, new-target notifications are working.

notificationAcceptedWarning.message: Chrome accepted the notification. It may not appear if Windows notifications are disabled.

outageNotificationMessage.message: $1 is unreachable from multiple external locations. The site may be broadly unavailable.

invalidPublicDomain.message: A valid public domain is required.

globalRateLimited.message: The global status service reached its request limit; try again later.

globalStartFailed.message: The global status measurement could not be started.

globalNoId.message: The global status service did not return a measurement ID.

globalReadFailed.message: The global status measurement could not be read.

globalTimedOut.message: The global status measurement did not finish in time.

localProxyFailed.message: Could not connect to the local proxy.

tabNotFound.message: The tab to reload was not found.

badgeTargetLearned.message: Automatic Access — new blocked target learned

badgeDirect.message: Automatic Access — this tab is connecting directly

badgeRouted.message: Automatic Access — this tab is using the local gateway

badgeUnavailable.message: Automatic Access — unavailable for this page

supportText.message: If Automatic Access helps you, you can support its development.
